1. Open a terminal.
2. Run the command with `sudo` to ensure you have the necessary permissions:

   ```bash
   sudo sh -c 'echo 0 > /proc/sys/kernel/randomize_va_space'
   ```

This command disables Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) on your system. Be cautious when changing system settings, as it can affect security.
